director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
pata nahi
Aaj hum scale se lambai naapenge, metre aur centimetre mein. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi, aap batao

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Cricket bat ka handle bhi scale se naapte hain. Scale par 0 se 1, 1 se 2, har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Pencil 0 se 7 tak rakhi hai: 7 khaane, toh 7 centimetre. Yeh hissa saaf hua?

seams.form: Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon.

director.text: mujhe lagta hai haan
Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: pata nahi
Crayon ke neeche wale khaane ek-ek karke gino, 3 wale nishaan se shuru karke. 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak rakhe crayon ki lambai kitni hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: Hindi mein bolo
Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon. 3 se 9 tak ke khaane gino. Crayon kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: 3 se 9 tak ke khaane gino. Crayon kitne centimetre ka hai?

seams.form: Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon.

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao

Socho, ek chinti 0 se chalti hai aur ek-ek khaana aage badhti hai. 7 tak pahunchne mein woh 7 khaane paar karti hai, isliye pencil 7 centimetre ki hai. 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak rakhe crayon ki lambai kitni hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 6 centimetre

Bilkul sahi: 3 se 9 tak 1-1 centimetre ke 6 khaane hain, yaani 9 − 3 = 6 centimetre. Scale ka pehla khaana 0 aur 1 ke beech hota hai. Jo cheez 1 se shuru hoti hai, uske neeche woh pehla khaana aata hi nahi. Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: sawaal kya hai?
1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak rakha patta kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: screen par dikhao na
Yahan wahi scale hai, aur patte ke sire se ginti shuru karke dikhayi hai: 1 se 2 tak pehla khaana. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

seams.form: Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

director.text: saat cm

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki pehla khaana patte ke neeche nahi aata. Golu ka scale toot gaya, ab woh 4 se shuru hota hai. Uske khaane bhi 1-1 centimetre ke hain: cheez jahan se shuru ho, wahin se khaane gino. Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: 8 sahi nahi hai. Ise doosri tarah samajhte hain. Nishaan nahi, khaane gino. 2 se 5 tak teen khaane hain: 2 se 3, 3 se 4, aur 4 se 5. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Ungli 6 wale nishaan par rakho, aur 10 tak ek-ek khaana kood kar jao. Har kood ek centimetre hai. Toote scale par 6 se 10 tak rakhi chabi kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 10 cm
Nahi, 10 cm theek nahi. 10 par chabi rukti hai, par shuru 6 par hoti hai; pehle wale khaane chabi mein nahi aate. Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

Haan, pehle tum try karo.

director.text: 10 cm

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Seedhi par chadhna socho: doosri paidi se paanchvi paidi tak 3 baar chadhna padta hai, 5 baar nahi. Scale par bhi nishaanon ke beech ke khaane hi lambai hain. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 10 cm
Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Aakhri nishaan mein se shuru ka nishaan ghatao. Jitna bache, utne hi khaane cheez ke neeche hain. Toote scale par 6 se 10 tak rakhi chabi kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 4 centimetre

Bilkul sahi. Chabi ke neeche chaar khaane aate hain, 6 se 10 tak: 10 − 6 = 4. Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

seams.form: Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: Nahi, 8 theek nahi. 8 toh pencil ki lambai hai, nishaan nahi; pencil 4 se shuru hokar 8 khaane aage jaati hai. 4 ke nishaan se rakhi 8 centimetre ki pencil ka doosra sira kis nishaan par hoga?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: 12 wala nishaan

Haan, bilkul theek: 4 se aage 8 khaane chalo toh 12 aata hai: 4 + 8 = 12. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge. Golu ka toota scale 4 ke nishaan se shuru hota hai. Uspar ek tehni 5 ke nishaan se 12 ke nishaan tak rakhi hai. Tehni ki lambai nikaalni hai. Tehni ki lambai ke liye 12 mein se kaunsa nishaan ghataoge?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge.

director.text: phir se bolo
12 wale nishaan mein se kis nishaan ko ghatane par tehni ki lambai milegi?
Yeh jawab nahi hai. Tehni 5 se shuru hoti hai, scale ke 4 se nahi. Isliye 12 mein se 5 ghatayenge. Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 12 cm
12 cm sahi nahi hai. 12 tehni ka doosra sira hai, lambai nahi; lambai ke liye shuru wala nishaan bhi dekhna hota hai. Toote scale par 5 se 12 tak rakhi tehni kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 7 cm hai na

Bilkul sahi. Toh poora jawab: tehni 7 centimetre lambi hai, kyunki 12 − 5 = 7 khaane tehni ke neeche hain, aur har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

director.text: chaar cm
Haan, bilkul theek. Rubber ke neeche 5 se 6, 6 se 7, 7 se 8 aur 8 se 9: 4 khaane, toh 4 centimetre. Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?
director.card: Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?

director.text: neela crayon
Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Jo crayon 9 tak jaata hai, woh chalta 3 se hai; uski lambai 9 − 3 hai, poora 9 nahi. 0 se 7 tak wala laal crayon aur 3 se 9 tak wala neela crayon: inmein lamba kaunsa hai?
director.card: Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?

director.text: laal crayon

Sahi jawab, kyunki neela 3 se chalkar 9 tak jaata hai, toh bas 6 centimetre; laal poore 7, isliye laal lamba. Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

director.text: nine

Haan, sahi hai. Ginti grip ke shuru wale 6 se hoti hai, toh 15 − 6 = 9 khaane, yaani 9 centimetre. Chhoti cheezein centimetre mein naapte hain. Ab dekhenge ki lambi cheezon ke liye metre kya hai, aur ek metre mein kitne centimetre. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, yeh naap le lene ke baad. Chalo, pehle yahan se aage badhte hain. Yeh ek metre ki lakdi hai. Ispar 0 se 100 tak centimetre likhe hain: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. Toh 1 metre mein 100 centimetre hote hain. Ab tak samajh aaya?

seams.form: Chalo, pehle yahan se aage badhte hain.

director.text: samajh nahi aaya

Socho, ek-ek centimetre ke sau chhote khaane ek qatar mein lage hon. Itni lambi lakdi ek metre hai, poore 100 centimetre. Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: phir bhi samajh nahi aaya
Bat ke upar 70 se 100 tak dekho. Lakdi ka har chhota khaana 10 centimetre ka hai; wahan ke centimetre gino. 70 ke nishaan tak aane wala bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: 70 cm
70 cm sahi nahi hai. 70 toh bat ki apni lambai hai; poocha yeh hai ki bat ke upar se metre ke aakhri nishaan tak kitna bacha. Tumhari baari hai, aaram se socho aur bolo.
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

seams.form: Tumhari baari hai, aaram se socho aur bolo.

director.text: 70 cm

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Ek metre bada hai: usmein 100 chhote centimetre aate hain. Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: tees centimetre
Bilkul sahi: metre 100 centimetre ka hai aur bat 70 tak aata hai, toh 100 − 70 = 30 centimetre bacha. Cricket mein kya kuch aisa hai jise tum naap sakte ho?
ab main jaati hoon, bye
Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain!
